objective: inverse inclusion weighted fit originals, each averaged over valid equal-weight horizons; CE + 0.5 Brier + 0.5 normalized RPS

history.layout: Ascending daily log return, open/close, high above max(open,close), low below min(open,close), and median-relative volume
history.near_zero: Signed quarter unit preserves nonzero direction. Literal zero is exact.

scalar.returns_vol_drawdown_gap_dispersion_turn: 1 basis point, with signed quarter basis point near zero
scalar.amounts: million quote/reporting currency or million shares, 3 significant digits
scalar.quote_prices_counts_and_ages: source quote units or integer counts, up to 8 significant digits
scalar.coverage: all distinct coverage groups and status; count share inferred only when exact
scalar.omitted_fields: missing; stock 60-day daily volatility is the decision sigma

display.choice_bounds: native ordered 1/5/20-session seven-bin interval, 12 significant digits in percent, exact zero bin
